issues.description: Constructor mismatch for Bookstore.init(books: ...): the problem statement (and the client call site) expect an initializer taking an Array of Book (init(books: [Book])) but the implementation in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift declares init(books: Set<Book>). This also conflicts with the Bookstore.books property which is declared as [Book] in the same file, and with the call return Bookstore(books: books) in Client.swift where a [Book] is passed. The inconsistent constructor signature will cause a compilation error and will confuse students about the required initializer type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bookstore initializer signature consistent with the problem statement and client usage. Change the constructor in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to: init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books } so the parameter type is [Book]. Alternatively (less preferred for this exercise) change the books property and all call sites to use Set<Book> consistently, but prefer the array signature [Book] to match the specification and example client code.
